newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chi Cheung in HK$205 mln property sale.
newsitem.headline: Chi Cheung in HK$205 mln property sale.

text.p: Chi Cheung Investment Co Ltd said on Friday that its Pacific South (Asia) Holdings Ltd unit had agreed to sell a property on Hong Kong island to Million Unity International Ltd for HK$205 million.
The 13,742-square-foot (1,278-square-metre) property consists of the entire 20th floor of Nine Queen's Road Central, in Hong Kong's Central district, Chi Cheung said in a statement.

It said the net carrying value of the property is HK$201.5 million and Chi Cheung would realise a book profit of about HK$1.8 million on completion of the sale. The net proceeds from the sale would be used for general working capital.
"The directors of the company consider that the purchase price of approximately HK$14,917 per square foot of gross floor area represents the current market price of the property," Chi Chueng said.
Chi Cheung unit Jewell Holdings owns 50 percent of Pacific South, while Chi Cheung chairman Paul Ng and his family own 50 percent.
